_comment: Subscription-backed lanes only. GPT lanes run through OpenCode on the OpenAI endpoint; Claude lanes run as Claude Code subagents on a Claude subscription. No prepaid-credit lanes (OpenRouter, Gemini, Grok): on the first hand-driven run a prepaid balance ran out mid-round and took three lanes down at once. Variants: xhigh works on the OpenAI endpoint; do not pass --variant to OpenRouter-hosted Anthropic models, they exit without joining.
